description: Consider the spiral of numbers in the upper half-plane with its cells numbered as in A396617, but starting at 0. Two players, Black and Red, take turns. When it is Black's turn, he places a knight at the smallest unoccupied cell not attacked by an existing Red knight, and when it is Red's turn, she places a knight at the smallest unoccupied cell not attacked by an existing Black knight. Sequence lists squares occupied by a Red knight.
